title: label
description: Object containing information for the label

carrier.description: The carrier for this shipment; Required if rateShopType is not defined.

serviceLevel.description: The service level for this shipment; Required if rateShopType is not defined.

rateShopType.description:
Required if serviceLevel is undefined and ignored if serviceLevel is defined; used to set the logic for determining the serviceLevel from rate shop results for label generation.
  * `BestCostPromisedDelivery` - Returns the lowest cost serviceLevel that meets the desiredDeliveryDate exactly, and fails if no serviceLevel qualifies. Also returns the shipDate that must be used to achieve the desiredDeliveryDate.
  * `BestCostMandatoryTransit` - Returns the lowest cost serviceLevel that is on or before the desiredDeliveryDate, and fails if no serviceLevel qualifies.
  * `BestCostOptionalTransit` - Returns the lowest cost serviceLevel that is on or before the desiredDeliveryDate; if no serviceLevel qualifies, returns the lowest cost serviceLevel overall.
  * `BestCost` - Returns the lowest cost serviceLevel; ignores desiredDeliveryDate.

shipDate.description: Required; must be in ISO 8601 format. For FedEx, shipDate must not be more than 10 days in the future.

invoiceDate.description: Required for UPS shipments only. Must be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Used exclusively for UPS Paperless Invoice to process customs declarations, and must match the shipment's invoice date.

rateShopCarrierList.description: Optional; limits the rate shop to only the carriers specified. By default, all configured carriers are rated.

transactionId.description: Optional; Unique identifier to correlate to the label request. If not populated, a random GUID will be used.

desiredDeliveryDate.description: Required if rateShopType is set to BestCostOptionalTransit, BestCostMandatoryTransit, or BestCostPromisedDelivery; must be in ISO 8601 format

packages.description: Can define multiple packages to create multiple labels if destinations are identical.

isHazardous.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials.

deliveryServiceList.description: Used to specify special delivery service options (these services may incur additional charges).

documents.description: Supporting documents to send to the carrier as part of the label request.

referenceNumbers.description: Additional reference number objects pertaining to the whole order.

rmaReason.description: The RMA reason for FedEx return shipments.

labelResolution.description: The DPI value to use for ZPL label generation; applies to UPS, FedEx, DHL and Purolator.

AESTransactionNumber.description: AES ITN may be required if shipping internationally from the US and the value is over 2,500.00 USD; must be exactly 14 digits and prefixed with X.

additionalLocationLabels.description: List of additional locations to provide extra information for customs purposes. (Only supported for UPS paperless Invoice and FedEx).

additionalLocationType.description: Required; List of supported additional location types for UPS and FedEx customs purposes.

customerLocationId.description: Customer defined identifier associated to a specific location; Optional, but required if C.H. Robinson has parcel account information on file for the location that must be passed to the carrier.

contactName.description: Required; The name of the contact person for the location.

contactPhoneNumber.description: Required; The phone number of the contact person for the location. For UPS, the max length is shorter at 15 characters.

address.description: Object that contains address specific information.

address1.description: Required; Indicates address line one of the location.

address2.description: Indicates address line two of the location.

address3.description: Indicates address line three of the location.

address4.description: Indicates address line four of the location.

city.description: Required; Indicates the city of the location.

stateProvinceCode.description: Indicates the state or province of the location. Required if countryCode is one of the following - AF, AR, AU, BR, CA, CN, ES, IT, KR, MX, PF, PG, PW, RU, SC, TH, TO, TV, US, USA, UY, VE, VN

postalCode.description: Indicates the postal code of the location, sometimes refered to as the zip code. Required unless countryCode is one of the following - AE, AG, AO, AW, BF, BI, BJ, BM, BO, BQ, BS, BW, BZ, CD, CF, CG, CI, CK, CM, CW, DJ, DM, ER, FJ, GA, GD, GH, GM, GQ, GY, HK, JM, KI, KM, KN, KP, LY, MO, MR, MW, PS, QA, RW, SB, SC, SL, SR, SS, ST, SX, SY, TD, TF, TG, TK, TL, TO, TV, UG, VU, YE, ZW

billTo.description: The bill to on the order.

customerCode.description: C.H. Robinson defined bill to customer code. This will be provided by your C.H. Robinson rep.

currencyCode.description:
Code to indicate the currency being used. The most common currently in use with C.H. Robinson:

* `USD` - US Dollar
* `CAD` - Canadian Dollar 
* `MXN` - Mexican Peso
* `EUR` - European Euro

referenceNumbers.description: Additional reference number objects pertaining to the customer object.

bookingNumber.description: The booking number for FedEx heavy air shipments.

carrierEnum.description: The list of supported small parcel carriers

countryOfOriginCode.description: Indicates country of origin of the contents; Required for all international shipments.

description.description: Description of the contents of the package; Required for all international shipments.

commodityCode.description: Code used by customs authorities to identify products when assessing duties and taxes. Required for DHL Paperless International Shipments.

value.description: Approximate value of the contents for customs purposes; Required for all international shipments.

currencyCode.description: Currency code tied to the value; Required for all international shipments.

quantity.description: Number of pieces in the package; Required for all international shipments.

quantityUnitOfMeasure.description: Quantity unit of measurement for the contents of the package. Required for UPS Paperless Invoice.

weight.description: Weight of the contents of the package; Required for all international shipments. For a given package, the sum of the weight of the contents must be less than or equal to the package weight.

weightUnitOfMeasure.description: Weight unit of measurement for the contents of the package; Required for all international shipments, and must match package weightUnitOfMeasure.

eccn.description: Export Control Classification Number; reserved for future use.

countryCodeEnum.description: Indicate the country of the location. For a detailed description of all enumerated codes please find them here.

currencyCodeEnum.description: Code to indicate the currency being used. The most common currently in use with C.H. Robinson: * `USD` - US Dollar * `CAD` - Canadian Dollar * `MXN` - Mexican Peso * `EUR` - European Euro For a detailed description of all enumerated codes please find them here.

currencyCodeLabelsEnum.description:
Code to indicate the currency being used. The most common currently in use with C.H. Robinson:

* `USD` - US Dollar
* `CAD` - Canadian Dollar 
* `MXN` - Mexican Peso
* `EUR` - European Euro

customerCode.description: C.H. Robinson defined customer code. This will be provided by your C.H. Robinson rep.

referenceNumbers.description: Additional reference number objects pertaining to the customer object.

fileName.description: Filename with extension; supported extensions are PDF, TXT, PNG, JPG/JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIF/TIFF, RTF, DOC, DOCX, XLS and XLSX.

documentUploadType.description: The type of document being uploaded.

documentUploadCategory.description: The category of the document being uploaded. FedEx only.

expirationDate.description: Date upon which the carrier can discard the document, and must be in ISO 8601 format. FedEx only.

content.description: Base64 encoded file data; maximum size per file is 10MB for UPS, 5MB for FedEx, and 2MB for DHL.

dutyPayerAccountNumber.description: Account number of the party paying the duty charges; Required for a dutyPayerType of Third_Party or if C.H. Robinson does not have the billing account to use on file.

exportReasonCode.description: A value required for DHL international shipments indicating why the shipment is being exported.

hazardousClassDivisionNumberEnum.description: The list of supported hazardous material classes

massCapacity.description: The mass capacity of the hazardous material; Required for FedEx Express Service Levels and for UPS if commodityRegulationType is ExceptedQuantity, LimitedQuantity, or FullyRegulated and if the field applies to the material by regulation.

massCapacityUnitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure for the mass capacity of the hazardous material; Required when massCapacity is provided.

containerType.description: The type of container used to hold the hazardous material. Ex. glass jug, fiberboard box, plastic bottle; Required for FedEx Express Service Levels and for UPS if commodityRegulationType is LimitedQuantity or FullyRegulated and if the field applies to the material by regulation.

containerQuantity.description: The number of identical containers in the package holding the same hazardous material; Required for UPS if commodityRegulationType is LimitedQuantity or FullyRegulated and if the field applies to the material by regulation.

outerPackagingType.description: The type of nested packaging used to encapsulate the inner containers with the hazardous material. Ex. For a large box containing plastic bottles of alcohol inside small boxes, this would describe the small boxes containing the plastic bottles; Reserved for future use.

outerPackagingQuantity.description: The number of nested packages used to encapsulate the inner containers with the hazardous material. Ex. For a large box containing plastic bottles of alcohol inside small boxes, this would count the small boxes containing the plastic bottles; Reserved for future use.

regulationSet.description: The hazardous material shipping regulation set applicable to the hazardous material; Required for UPS.

regulatoryIdNumber.description: Required; The UN/NA/ID Identification Number assigned to the hazardous material.

hazardClassDivisionNumber.description: The primary hazard class or division number assigned to the hazardous material; Required for UPS if commodityRegulationType is ExceptedQuantity, LimitedQuantity, or FullyRegulated and if the field applies to the material by regulation.

subHazardClassDivisions.description: The subsidary hazard class or division numbers assigned to the hazardous material; Optional.

packingGroup.description: The IATA packing group for the hazardous material; Required for FedEx and TNT, and required for UPS if commodityRegulationType is LimitedQuantity or FullyRegulated and if the field applies to the material by regulation.

packagingInstructionCode.description: The code for the packaging instructions used to pack the hazardous material; Required for FedEx Express Service Levels and for UPS if commodityRegulationType is LimitedQuantity or FullyRegulated and if the field applies to the material by regulation.

properShippingName.description: The proper shipping name for the hazardous material assigned by ADR, CFR or IATA; Required for UPS and TNT.

technicalName.description: The technical name for the hazardous material; Required for UPS if commodityRegulationType is LimitedQuantity or FullyRegulated and if the field applies to the material by regulation and if the field applies to the material by regulation.

isAccessible.description: Indicates whether or not the hazardous material is accessible by the carrier during transport (ex. accessible by the flight crew in-flight); FedEx Only.

commodityRegulationLevel.description: The regulation level for the hazardous material; Required for UPS and TNT.

transportationMode.description: The transportation mode that the hazardous material was prepared for; Required for UPS if regulationSet is anything other than ADR or if commodityRegulationType is LimitedQuantity or FullyRegulated.

emergencyContact.description: The name of the person to contact in the event of an emergency; Optional.

emergencyPhoneNumber.description: The telephone number to contact in the event of an emergency; Required for FedEx.

additionalDescription.description: Additional information about the hazardous material. This could be additional regulatory information, additional handling details, etc; Required for UPS if commodityRegulationType is LimitedQuantity or FullyRegulated and if the field applies to the material by regulation.

chemicalRecordIdentifier.description: Identifies the hazardous material in a package. If a package contains multiple hazardous materials, each one should be clearly labeled with an identifier so that it can be easily recognized; Required for UPS.

hazardousMaterialType.description: The type of hazardous material; Required for FedEx.

hazardousContentDescription.description: The hazardous material content ID; Required for DHL.

hazardousPackageInformation.description: Additional information about any hazardous materials or dangerous goods in the package.

hazardousMaterials.description: The list of hazardous materials in the package.

packagingType.description: The outermost type of packaging used for package containing hazardous materials. Ex. fiberboard box, steel drum, plastic jug; Reserved for future use.

isOverpack.description: A flag indicating if the package containing hazardous materials is an overpack; Optional.

isAllPackedInOne.description: A flag indicating if the package contains multiple containers with different hazardous materials; Optional.

qValue.description: The Q-Value of the package containing hazardous materials; Optional.

offeror.description: The offeror of the package containing hazardous materials; Required for FedEx.

internationalShipping.description: Elements specific to international shipping scenarios.

isDutiable.description: A flag required for DHL international shipments indicating whether or not the shipment is dutiable.

AESExempt.description: Indicates that goods being shipped are exempt from AES Export Filing; FedEx only, Optional.

dutyPayerType.description: Indicates which party involved in a shipment is responsible for duty payment; Required for all international shipments (including when the isDutiable flag is false).

dutyPayerPostalCode.description: Postal code of the party paying the duty charges; Used for a dutyPayerType of Third_Party.

dutyPayerCountryCode.description: Country code of the party paying the duty charges; Used for a dutyPayerType of Third_Party.

dutyPayerName.description: Indicates the company name tied to the duty payer account; Reserved for future use.

dutyPayerAddress1.description: Indicates address line one tied to the duty payer account; Reserved for future use.

dutyPayerAddress2.description: Indicates address line two tied to the duty payer account; Reserved for future use.

dutyPayerCity.description: Indicates the city tied to the duty payer account; Reserved for future use.

dutyPayerStateProvinceCode.description: Indicates the state or province of the tied to the duty payer account; Reserved for future use.

dutyPayerContactName.description: Indicates the name of the contact person tied to the duty payer account; Reserved for future use.

dutyPayerContactPhoneNumber.description: Indicates the phone number tied to the duty payer account; Reserved for future use.

incoTerms.description: Specifies who is responsible for paying for and managing the shipment; Optional - FedEx and DHL only.

isResidential.description: A flag indicating whether or not this is a residential location. Used ONLY FOR PARCEL Shipments. For FedEx, FedEx_Ground_Home_Delivery or Fedex_Home_Delivery must be used if the destination is residential.

labelReferenceData1.description: First piece of reference data to be used on the package label. This is used as the customer/shipper reference number on the label for FedEx, UPS, DHL, and TNT.

labelReferenceData2.description: Second piece of reference data to be used on the package label. This is used as the PO Number for FedEx or Reference Number 2 for UPS (not used for DHL or TNT).

labelReferenceData3.description: Third piece of reference data to be used on the package label. This is used as the Invoice Number for FedEx (not used for UPS, DHL, or TNT).

customerLocationId.description: Customer defined identifier associated to a specific location; Optional, but required if C.H. Robinson has parcel account information on file for the location that must be passed to the carrier.

name.description: Required; The name of the location.

contactName.description: Required; The name of the contact person for the location.

contactPhoneNumber.description: Required; The phone number of the contact person for the location. For UPS, the max length is shorter at 15 characters.

email.description: The email address of the contact person for the location.

referenceNumbers.description: Additional reference number objects pertaining to this location.

contents.description: Required for international shipments (origin and destination countryCode do not match). Itemized package contents.

deliveryConfirmation.description: Used on specify if signature is required on delivery (this service may incur additional charges).

documentsOnly.description: Used on DHL shipments to indicate if the package only contains documents.

declaredValue.description: Used to request package insurance (this service may incur additional charges)

declaredValueCurrencyCode.description: Code to indicate the currency being used for insurance; Required if declaredValue is populated.

collectOnDelivery.description: Used to request COD service from the parcel provider; Reserved for future use.

collectOnDeliveryAmount.description: Money value to collect upon delivery; Reserved for future use.

collectOnDeliveryCurrencyCode.description: Code to indicate the currency being used; Reserved for future use.

description.description: General description of the package contents for Returns Services.

packagingType.description: Required; Used to specify if prepaid carrier-branded envelopes or boxes are being used; Customer_Package should be passed if this is unknown.

weight.description: Required; weight of the package. Most parcel carriers enforce a maximum of 150 lbs or 68 kg.

length.description: Required; length of the package. Most parcel carriers enforce a maximum of 108 inches.

linearUnitOfMeasure.description: Required; units of measurement the length, width, and height are defined in. Metric values require the Package weightUnitOfMeasure to be Kilograms, and Imperial values require Pounds.

referenceNumbers.description: Additional reference number objects pertaining to the package object (do not show on label).

hazardousPackageInformation.description: Additional information about any hazardous materials or dangerous goods in the package.

payer.description: The party responsible for paying the shipping charges.

accountNumber.description: Account number of the party paying the shipping charges; Required for a payer type of Third_Party or if C.H. Robinson does not have the billing account to use on file.

postalCode.description: Indicates the postal code tied to the payer account; Required if accountNumber is specified.

countryCode.description: Indicates the country code tied to the payer account; Required if accountNumber is specified.

name.description: Indicates the company name tied to the payer account; Required for TNT Australia domestic Third Party shipments.

address1.description: Indicates address line one tied to the payer account; Required for TNT Australia domestic Third Party shipments.

address2.description: Indicates address line two tied to the payer account; Required for TNT Australia domestic Third Party shipments.

city.description: Indicates the city tied to the payer account; Required for TNT Australia domestic Third Party shipments.

stateProvinceCode.description: Indicates the state or province of the tied to the payer account; Required for TNT Australia domestic Third Party shipments.

contactName.description: Indicates the name of the contact person tied to the payer account; Required for TNT Australia domestic Third Party shipments.

contactPhoneNumber.description: Indicates the phone number tied to the payer account; Required for TNT Australia domestic Third Party shipments.

payerTypeEnum.description: Indicates which party involved in the shipment is responsible for payment.

type.description: C.H. Robinson defined code for reference number types. Here is a list of the most commonly used reference number types: `SHID` - Shipment ID #, `MBOL` - Master Bill of Lading #, `PO` - Purchase Order #, `BOL` - Bill of Lading #, `CRID` - Customer Specific Ref Number, `CUSTPO` - Customer PO Number, `DEL` - Delivery #, `JNO` - Job Number, `PU` - Pickup #, `CON` - Customer Order Number, `APPT` - Appointment Number For a detailed description of all enumerated codes please find them here.

value.description: The actual value of the reference number.

serviceLevelLabelsEnum.description: The list of supported small parcel carrier service levels

name.description: The name of the hazardous shipment signatory; Required for FedEx Express Service Levels.

title.description: The title of the hazardous shipment signatory; Required for FedEx Express Service Levels.

place.description: The place of the hazardous shipment signatory; Required for FedEx Express Service Levels.
